title: Six New Again 01–02
edition: 2026 direct-mail reissue of Six issues 1 and 2 (digest edition)

description.main: The first volume of Six New Again, the 2026 Comme des Garçons direct-mail reissue of Six, combining issues 1 and 2 of the 1988–91 magazine.
description.extended:
The first volume of Six New Again, the 2026 Comme des Garçons direct-mail revival of Six, the magazine the label published from 1988 to 1991 under the art direction of Tsuguya Inoue.

This volume combines the first two issues, with Issue 1 (1988) on the front cover and Issue 2 on the back. The originals measured 40 × 30 cm. The reissue is a 30 × 22 cm digest of about 40 pages, handed to customers at the launch of the season. It carries photographs by André Kertész, Peter Lindbergh, Minsei Tominaga, and Cecil Beaton. It also adds work by two postwar Japanese photographers, Takuma Nakahira and Kenshu Shintsubo, who were not in the original issues.

Six, short for the sixth sense, ran to eight issues between 1988 and 1991. Rei Kawakubo filled it with photography, art, design, and text, and the label gave it away instead of selling it. The 2026 reissue runs as four volumes. The library holds all four: 01–02, 03–04, 05, and 06+08. This is the first.

notes: Comme des Garçons 2026 direct mail. Issue 1 on the front cover, Issue 2 on the back. A separate 01–02 printing was issued for the Kyoto store renewal (page-spread listing); this record is the general direct-mail edition. The original Six (1988–1991, eight issues, art direction Tsuguya Inoue) measured 40 × 30 cm. Page count is the dealer's approximate figure (page-spread lists conflicting counts across its listings).
